why_not_fabricated: The available GitHub integration can read/write repository objects and inspect existing workflow runs, but it cannot execute `go test ./...` or add/run a fresh forensic harness. Therefore no candidate-level runtime counts or raw traces are asserted.
code_level_rejection_paths: selectMethod rejects all candidates lacking Verified && Regression && LeakFree && FutureTraceChanged
candidate_mechanism_group: At current generator depth with nil library: six depth-1 stream operators and thirty-six ordered depth-2 compositions. No acquired call candidates exist in V3 because the library argument is nil.
important_non-equivalence: A code-derived rejection path is not a raw execution rejection count. This artifact deliberately preserves NOT_EXECUTED rather than inventing a matrix.
